description:
We are Manya, Monica and Shayantra, three students who enjoy learning, exploring new ideas and trying out new things. We are curious, creative and hardworking, and we enjoy understanding concepts beyond what we learn in our textbooks. Each of us brings different ideas and perspectives, which makes working together a fun learning experience. We believe in sharing ideas, learning from our mistakes and helping each other whenever we face challenges. This project gave us an opportunity to bring our interests in science and creativity together and turn our ideas into something meaningful.

OUR PROJECT – MISSION: BEYOND
summary: Mission: Beyond is a NASA-inspired space adventure game that takes players across 10 different destinations. Through interactive missions, questions, mazes and rewards, players explore real space-related challenges while learning science in an enjoyable way. We believe every great discovery begins with curiosity, and there is always something new to explore!
details:
Mission: Beyond is a NASA-inspired educational space adventure game developed by Manya, Monica and Shayantra. As a team, we wanted to bring together our understanding of science and our imagination to create something that was not just informative but genuinely engaging. We spent time thinking about how space exploration could be turned into an experience where players could investigate real challenges, make decisions and learn through their own discoveries. Our aim was to combine scientific knowledge with creative gameplay and build something that could spark curiosity in others.

Our challenge, “Build a Junior Astronaut Mission,” inspired us to create a game that gives young learners a taste of what it takes to explore space. Mission: Beyond takes players across 10 space destinations, including the Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Deep Space. Each destination presents a challenge inspired by real space research, such as lunar dust, radiation, asteroids and space debris.

Players customise their astronauts, explore a star map and complete missions by answering questions. Each destination has five levels, with 10 questions per level. We have also included special power-ups, animated space environments, background music and voice instructions to make the experience more interactive.

Our aim is to help young aspiring astronauts develop scientific curiosity, logical thinking and problem-solving skills. By facing different challenges, players get an idea of the decisions and difficulties involved in real space exploration.


Inspired by genuine NASA research, Mission: Beyond turns scientific concepts into an exciting learning experience. We hope it encourages young minds to ask questions, explore science and dream about future discoveries.


We believe every great discovery begins with curiosity. Through Mission: Beyond, we hope to inspire the next generation to explore, learn and imagine what is possible beyond Earth.
